sources.entry: Devin - Autonomous AI software engineer for end-to-end tasks. #paid

summary.name: Devin
summary.one_liner: Devin is an AI coding agent from Cognition that works as an autonomous software engineer, running in the cloud or on a user's machine to build, test, and deliver code changes.
use_cases: delegate large coding tasks to parallel agents
fix bugs and failed CI automatically
review code for bugs and vulnerabilities
map codebase architecture and update diagrams
respond to tasks tagged in Slack or Teams
summary.what_it_does: Devin runs in the cloud or on the user's machine and can spin up its own Windows, Mac, and Linux virtual machines to build software, test it in a browser, and record itself clicking through the result. It can split a large task across parallel cloud agents, manage them, and report back. Users can tag @Devin in Slack, Teams, and other tools, and Devin reads the thread and responds to follow-ups. Devin Review looks for bugs and vulnerabilities before production and can be assigned to fix them. The page also describes scheduled workflows, trigger-based automations for alerts and failed CI, and a mix of models chosen per task.
notable: Runs its own Windows, Mac, and Linux VMs and records itself testing the app in a browser
Splits big tasks across parallel cloud agents
Devin Review finds bugs and vulnerabilities and can fix them with one click
Enterprise controls: zero data retention with model providers, audit logs, RBAC/SSO/SCIM/OIDC, private networking
caveats: Listed as paid; specific prices and plan tiers are not stated on the page text
Enterprise-oriented: page targets serious engineering teams
Private networking is described as available but no details are given
